slice: Emit a stable public well-known deployment identity manifest from every Vite build.

verification.source_review: The Vite plugin emits a deterministic JSON asset containing schema version, application, commit SHA, provider, deployment URL, and an explicit claim scope.
verification.local_execution: unavailable because the runtime did not provide gh CLI access to clone the private repository

safety.claim_boundary: The manifest proves build-time identity only after it is publicly fetched; it does not independently prove runtime correctness.

rollback.method: Revert commits in reverse order without force push.

next_action: After the Vercel rate limit clears, fetch the well-known manifest from the public deployment and compare commit_sha with the deployed source commit.
